integrity: Proof and finite checker are supplied; exact cycle counts are proved symbolically and verified independently at finite precisions. Uncertainty about unlocated equivalent literature is explicitly retained.
scientific_limitations: The result treats the Pell coefficient-two companion recurrence only, modulo powers of two; finite replay checks exponents up to eight. Unlocated general quadratic-unit theory may overlap, and independent audit has not been performed.
source_ids: Deveci-Karaduman, The Pell Sequences in Finite Groups, Utilitas Mathematica 96 (2015), pp. 263-276
Deveci-Akdeniz-Karaduman, The Generalized Pell p-Sequences in Groups, Ars Combinatoria 120 (2015), pp.383-401
Aydin-Dikici, General Fibonacci Sequences in Finite Groups, Fibonacci Quarterly 36 (1998), pp.216-221
title: Complete dyadic cycle census for the Pell companion recurrence
